Acbric quick start
==================

First setup
1. Extract the whole Acbric folder to a writable location. Install the game separately.
2. Open Setup.cmd. Use Find game in Steam, or Browse to the game folder containing Airships.json.
3. Usually keep the default instance folder. Select Check folders, then Save & create launcher.
First-time setup does not need Load saved setup (formerly Load existing instance); saving creates the configuration.
If loading on an older version reports a missing configuration, select Check folders, then save after checks pass.
If checking also fails, preserve the files and send the displayed log. Do not create an empty configuration.

Play next time
Double-click Start Acbric.cmd in this folder. You do not need to run setup again.
If you configured several instances, this entry starts the most recently saved one.

Install MODs
Put Java MOD .jar files and native MOD folders together in the mods folder here.
Native folders must directly contain info.json. Import .amod archives through the game's Install MOD action.
Acbric API is included; do not add a duplicate. Restart after adding or enabling/disabling Java MODs.
Old layouts/User folders are not imported automatically; close the game before copying wanted MODs.

Update or restore
1. Obtain a new Acbric-external-<version>.zip from a source you trust. Do not extract it over the old folder.
2. Close the game and Setup. Open Update Acbric.cmd and select the existing Acbric folder.
3. Choose Yes, select the ZIP, review the version and target, and update.
   MODs, instances, saves and settings are preserved. Failed updates attempt automatic restoration.
4. To return to the previous framework, open the updater and choose No.
   After an interrupted update, the updater first offers recovery. Recover before launching the game.
First upgrade from dev.28: extract the new release elsewhere, run its Update Acbric.cmd, and select the old Acbric folder as the target.
If the old release has no updater, or its entry is unavailable after interruption, run the updater from a separately extracted new release and select the original folder.
Manually changed framework files stop the update and are preserved. Read the log; do not discard the backups.
Rollback restores framework files only, not saves or MOD data. An older framework may not understand data saved after updating.

Files and troubleshooting
Setup can open MOD, instance and log folders. Saves and native settings are in instance/userdata.
Launch logs: instance/logs/acbric/launcher. Native game log: instance/userdata/log.txt.
The updater displays its log path. Backups are kept under Acbric/.acbric-maintenance without automatic cleanup.
After relocating the framework, game or instance, open Setup at the new location, load the instance, check and save.
Keep CMD files in place. Create a shortcut to Start Acbric.cmd for desktop access.

Full instructions: INSTALLER.md. 中文：使用说明.txt
